notes: Cash-basis school district. Governmental receipts/disbursements use the Total Governmental Funds column (p5, after the Reclassifications column; p4 holds the labels). Reclassifications column eliminates 345,000 of hidden General Fund transfers (95,000 to Cooperative inside Regular instruction, 250,000 to Depreciation inside Plant operation and maintenance) plus internal transfers, so total-column transfers net to zero and top-level transfers are null. Identity: 8,937,714 + 15,956,500 - 15,442,109 = 9,452,105. Debt service line (802,090) split into principal 685,000 and interest/fees 117,090 using fund schedules (Bond p20, General p16, QCPUF p26). Poverty programs and Special education instruction programs are printed under Support services on the statement; classified as instruction by category definition (review). Business-type = School Nutrition fund (p7); printed Federal and State reimbursements 311,943 split into federal 308,584 and state 3,359 per p21; business reported receipts 491,650 as printed on p8 (operating 173,967 + nonoperating 317,683 on p7). Balance sheet: Statement of Net Position - Cash Basis Total column (p1); no liabilities. Detail: General Fund receipts from budget schedule (p9-10); General Fund spending from Exhibit of operational expenses (p11-16), which supersedes the function-only lines on p10 (not recorded again). Exhibit contains no line for the 345,000 hidden transfers, so two contra lines (-95,000 regular instruction, -250,000 plant) plus other financing lines were added (review); General expenditure detail_total therefore computed 13,046,962. General fund transfers: +17,297 from Bond (matches Bond transfer out 17,297), -75,000 to Activities (matches Activities transfer in 75,000), -95,000 Cooperative and -250,000 Depreciation (match receiving funds). Activities Fund recorded account by account (receipts column 1710 and disbursements column 2900; zero accounts skipped); the p8 combined schedule and function-only p10 disbursement lines are not recorded to avoid double counting. Bond Fund and QCPUF budget-only lines (miscellaneous 50,000; bond issuance 599,500) have no actual and are omitted. Bond fund total cash disbursements 737,058 includes the 17,297 transfer.
